subject: Geography
title: Climate: Elements, Controls and Climate Types
description: Weather and climate, factors controlling climate, and the climates of Cameroon and Africa.

questions.prompt: The average weather conditions of a place over about 30 years is called its…
Temperature generally decreases with altitude at a rate of about…
Rain formed when moist air is forced to rise over a mountain is…
Debundscha, at the foot of Mount Cameroon, is one of the wettest places on Earth mainly because of…
options: Moist south-west monsoon winds rising over the mountain

questions.prompt: The dry, dusty north-east wind that blows from the Sahara across West Africa is the…
Places near the equator, such as southern Cameroon, have…
options: High temperatures and rainfall in most months

questions.prompt: Why are coastal areas cooler in summer and milder in winter than inland areas?
options: Coastal areas are at higher altitude
The sun shines less at the coast
The sea heats up and cools down more slowly than land

questions.prompt: The Inter-Tropical Convergence Zone (ITCZ) mainly brings…
options: Rainfall as it migrates north and south

questions.prompt: The Sahel zone of northern Cameroon has a climate that is…
options: Hot and semi-arid with a short rainy season
